rules.chaotic: hidden_chaos.classify 'hidden chaos' in either line file (no state period, exponent > 1e-3 at both offsets, periodic leading token), merged by log10 T; sorted by log10 T; development = ranks floor((2i + 1) N / 16), i = 0..7
rules.periodic: state period 7 and leading-token period 7 in either line file, merged by log10 T; 16 at ranks floor((2i + 1) N / 32); development = positions 4 and 12 of these 16
rules.text_period: lcm of the line files' leading-token periods
rules.states: X_t at t = 1070 + k s, k = 0..15, s = q ceil(70 / q)
